A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
